verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Napa Valley wine country, steps from Beringer Vineyards and minutes to downtown St. Helena.
verified_facts.excerpt: steps from Beringer Vineyards and minutes to downtown St. Helena, Alila Napa Valley is a journey of epicurean discovery

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set next to a historic estate winery, with views of Napa Valley vineyards and mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy sweeping vistas of Napa Valley vineyards and mountains, all set next to a historic estate winery.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites were designed by Yabu Pushelberg.
verified_facts.excerpt: interiors designed by the renowned team at Yabu Pushelberg

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have oversize balconies or wraparound terraces with outdoor fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature oversize balconies or wraparound terraces with outdoor fireplaces

verified_facts.text: Rooms have bespoke Italian furnishings, luxury linens and spa-inspired bathrooms with rain showers and soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooms and suites include bespoke Italian furnishings, luxury linens and spa-inspired bathrooms with rain showers and soaking tubs

verified_facts.text: Streamside Suites have a balcony over York Creek with an outdoor dining set, firepit and soaking tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy floor-to-ceiling glass doors that open onto a spacious balcony with an outdoor dining set for four, firepit, and soaking tub.

verified_facts.text: Historic Manor rooms are in a lovingly restored manor house with town or vineyard views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience an unforgettable Napa Valley getaway in a lovingly restored manor house with town or vineyard views.

verified_facts.text: The heated outdoor pool is set against the Mayacamas Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set against the stunning Mayacamas Mountains, swim laps or lounge at our heated outdoor pool

verified_facts.text: Reserved poolside cabanas include dining service, a lounging sofa and a private minifridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: your reserved cabana, including dining service, a dedicated lounging sofa and a private minifridge

verified_facts.text: Spa Alila treatments use healing herbal remedies, basalt stones from the California coastline, obsidian gua sha stones and local handcrafted products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nature takes center stage with healing herbal remedies, basalt stones from the California coastline, obsidian gua sha stones and local, handcrafted ingredients and products.

verified_facts.text: Spa Alila has a steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in our steam room and rediscover your center with a soothing meditation.

verified_facts.text: Wellness experiences include forest bathing, astrology readings after dark, new moon yoga and vineyard-view painting.
verified_facts.excerpt: From forest bathing sessions and astrology readings after dark to new moon yoga and vineyard-view painting

verified_facts.text: Pedal and Pour is a guided bike ride through vineyards with Olabisi Wines founder Ted Osborne, including a barrel tasting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join Ted Osborne, founder and vintner of Olabisi Wines, for an intimate guided journey through the vineyards of the St Helena and Calistoga AVAs.

verified_facts.text: Guests can create a custom room and aura mist with an expert perfumer using local botanicals.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’ll craft your own custom room and aura mist using local botanicals

verified_facts.text: A hands-on falconry experience introduces guests to birds of prey and raptor conservation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meet majestic birds of prey during a hands-on falconry experience with Alila Napa Valley. Gain insight into raptor conservation

verified_facts.text: A tasting of historic cabernet sauvignon vintages can be hosted at the Rhine House or in a guest suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy an exclusive tasting featuring historic cabernet sauvignon vintages. Compare wines across decades at the Rhine House or from your suite overlooking the vineyard

verified_facts.text: Violetto blends French culinary techniques with Italian flavors, with a prix fixe menu featuring handmade pasta.
verified_facts.excerpt: Violetto, our St. Helena hotel restaurant, blends the elegance of French culinary techniques with the warmth of Italian flavors for a refined dining experience. The prix fixe menu features handmade pasta

verified_facts.text: Salvia Terrace and Bar is an indoor-outdoor restaurant and bar serving breakfast, lunch and dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: Salvia Terrace & Bar is a Napa Valley restaurant and indoor-outdoor bar offering a relaxed, vibrant dining experience. Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner

verified_facts.text: The resort is tailored to adult guests, and rooms are limited to two guests each, including minors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alila Napa Valley is tailored to adult guests and those seeking tranquility. To preserve this peaceful atmosphere, our accommodations are limited to a maximum of two guests per room, including minors.

verified_facts.text: The main building is a Georgian Revival-style mansion dating to 1905 that houses four guest rooms and the two restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: an all-white Georgian Revival–style mansion dating back to 1905 that also houses the two on-site restaurants

verified_facts.text: The property opened as Las Alcobas Napa Valley in 2017 and became Alila Napa Valley in 2021.
verified_facts.excerpt: Additional buildings were added in 2017 when the property opened as a hotel, then named Las Alcobas Napa Valley. It transformed into Alila Napa Valley in 2021.

verified_facts.text: Beringer Winery is reached via the resort's footbridge, the Bridge to Beringer.
verified_facts.excerpt: accessible via the resort’s footbridge—dubbed the “Bridge to Beringer”—located by the fitness center

verified_facts.text: There is a dedicated non-alcoholic bar with a spirit-free menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s also a non-alcoholic bar (Napa’s only dedicated one) showcasing a new spirit-free menu

verified_facts.text: Streamside Premium rooms have a curtained balcony with an outdoor tub and a firepit.
verified_facts.excerpt: This premium room also offers a curtained balcony with an outdoor tub and a firepit.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has treadmills, Peloton bikes, free weights, yoga balls and mats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our fitness center offers high-end equipment like treadmills, Peloton bikes, free weights, yoga balls and mats, and more.
